premise: Stegosaurus wonders what the leaves at the very top of the monkey-puzzle tree taste like; T. rex stretches on tiptoe and can't get anywhere near, and Brachiosaurus stretches his long neck right up to the top — and reports they are prickly.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Fox and the Grapes' turned: the friend who can reach does, and tells the truth — they really are too prickly for anyone but him.
lesson: What suits one friend may not suit another, and that is fine.
learning: Brachiosaurus reached leaves at the tops of tall trees with its long neck.

en-US.title: The Top of the Tree
en-US.text: {stegosaurus:enter} {stegosaurus:go to meadow} Stegosaurus was munching ferns, low down in the meadow. {stegosaurus:live munch} Munch, munch. Then he looked up… and up… {stegosaurus:face surprised} at the very top of the monkey-puzzle tree. [curious] "I wonder what those leaves taste like." {trex:enter} {trex:go to stegosaurus} T. rex came stomping over. {trex:face happy} "I'll get you one!" He stood on tiptoe and {trex:live reach hold} stretched his tiny arms up high. Higher! Higher! [giggles] Not even close. {trex:live reach resume} T. rex gave a little shrug. {stegosaurus:face sad} [sighs] Oh well. Then — {sfx:steps} thump… thump… along came {brachiosaurus:enter} Brachiosaurus. [warmly] "Allow me." {brachiosaurus:live stretch-neck hold} Up went his long, long neck, all the way to the very highest leaves. {sfx:rustle} Rustle, rustle. {brachiosaurus:live stretch-neck resume} Down it came, with a mouthful. {brachiosaurus:live munch} Munch… munch… {stegosaurus:face normal} "Well?" asked Stegosaurus. {brachiosaurus:face happy} "PRICKLY," said Brachiosaurus, chewing happily. "Just how I like them." {trex:wobble} T. rex giggled. {stegosaurus:face happy} Stegosaurus looked at his soft ferns. "I think I'll stay down here." [happily] So the tall one ate up high, the low one ate down low… and T. rex {trex:live jump} jumped, just to say he'd tried.

es-ES.title: Lo más alto del árbol
es-ES.text: {stegosaurus:enter} {stegosaurus:go to meadow} Estegosaurio mordisqueaba helechos, bien bajito, en el prado. {stegosaurus:live munch} Ñam, ñam. Entonces miró hacia arriba… muy arriba… {stegosaurus:face surprised} a la copa de la araucaria. [curious] —¿A qué sabrán esas hojas de ahí arriba? {trex:enter} {trex:go to stegosaurus} T. rex llegó dando zancadas. {trex:face happy} —¡Yo te cojo una! Se puso de puntillas y {trex:live reach hold} estiró sus bracitos todo lo que pudo. ¡Más! ¡Más! [giggles] Ni de lejos. {trex:live reach resume} T. rex se encogió de hombros. {stegosaurus:face sad} [sighs] Vaya. Y entonces… {sfx:steps} pum… pum… llegó {brachiosaurus:enter} Braquiosaurio. [warmly] —Ya voy yo. {brachiosaurus:live stretch-neck hold} Su cuello largo, larguísimo, subió y subió hasta las hojas más altas de todas. {sfx:rustle} Fru, fru. {brachiosaurus:live stretch-neck resume} Y bajó con la boca llena. {brachiosaurus:live munch} Ñam… ñam… {stegosaurus:face normal} —¿Y bien? —preguntó Estegosaurio. {brachiosaurus:face happy} —PINCHAN —dijo Braquiosaurio, masticando tan contento—. ¡Como a mí me gustan! {trex:wobble} T. rex se rio. {stegosaurus:face happy} Estegosaurio miró sus helechos blanditos. —Creo que me quedo aquí abajo. [happily] Así que el alto comió arriba, el bajito comió abajo… y T. rex {trex:live jump} dio un salto, solo para decir que lo había intentado.
